summary: Effect sizes are available in bulk only for human GWAS (1,205,644 associations in the GWAS Catalog, no adaptive context) and in single-system QTL datasets such as the stickleback skeletal map; Animal QTLdb was under maintenance and the Chromosome Counts Database gave no confirmed record count, and no cross-taxon compilation of effect sizes of adaptive alleles was found.
next_step: Compile a table of adaptive-allele effect sizes from published QTL/GWAS meta-analyses and the single-system Dryad datasets, and add chromosome counts for the polyploidy arm; re-check Animal QTLdb when it is back.
obstacles_confirmed: GWAS and QTL samples are biased toward large effects and toward crops, livestock, and humans.
The phrase 'infinitesimally small' lacks a unique modern threshold.
